entries.question: Why did the harness appear silent after a D2 enable?
ruled_out: a device-level difference between app and harness
a capability limit of the harness
entries.best_evidence: Two independent facts. (1) The harness streams: 3,292 valid frames / 26 ids in the 2026-09-27 17:08 run under 0B -> D2 ON with no pre-clear. (2) PROVEN LIVE 2026-09-28: case C0 - WITH the D2 OFF pre-clear and a confirmed A-twice press - produced 167 valid frames including PRESS/RELEASE/PRESS/RELEASE on bit 0, while 0 frames arrived before the press and after the release. So the historical differential windows were silent because no physical press was requested in them, not because of any protocol state. EXPLANATION RECORDED, NOT ERASED: see results/reconciliation/d2-u007-harness-streaming-reconciliation.md and results/experiments/d2-c0-physical-20260928-054549/RESULT.md

entries.question: Does RT report analog travel, and does it have a digital key id on this unit?
entries.best_evidence: closure session (2026-09-28): two full pulls produced zero frames - a method-limited negative, since RT alone emits no frame; [16] was UNSAMPLED, not measured zero. | piggyback session (2026-09-28): with A forcing transmission, byte[16] = 0 at rest and 255 at full pull in every A-caused frame (40/40 in P2, 52/52 in the repeat) while byte[15] stayed flat - LT positive control proven on the same method. A digital bit 9 appeared only in the RT-held windows (513/512; 107 frames P2, 144 P2R; absent in P0 and P1) and is preserved UNNAMED.

entries.question: What real DPI value does selector N mean?
entries.best_evidence: STATIC (2026-09-28): the writer `A5 05 FC <selector & 0x0F>` carries ONLY a 4-bit selector - no value byte, no clamp beyond the mask, and no numeric table anywhere in the binary. The preset table is server-side, which is why no selector->DPI mapping can be recovered from the APK.
entries.next_offline_step: none left in the APK for the numeric mapping; only a per-selector live differential of the reported DPI (deferred, needs a read path that returns a value)
entries.next_hardware_step: none useful without the vendor table

entries.question: What is the shape of the DPI reply, and does it carry a value?
entries.best_evidence: LIVE: TX `A5 05 FC 80 26` -> RX `A5 05 FF FC A5`. STATIC (2026-09-28): the reply family is `A5 <len> FF <echoed opcode> <cks>`; byte[3] echoes the queried opcode; the captured reply has ZERO payload, so this query returns no numeric DPI value. The chained read (getDpi then getStepLength inside one notification handler) shows the official workflow is a read sequence.
entries.next_offline_step: find the 0xFF dispatch table and the per-opcode handlers; determine whether any 0xFF reply carries a payload at all
entries.next_hardware_step: re-read the query and vary the selector while capturing, to see which field moves

entries.question: Which physical control owns digital bit 9?
entries.best_evidence: RESOLVED by one-variable confirmation (2026-09-28): one connection, one D2 session, three windows - W0 A-only (228 valid frames, bit 9 in 0), W1 RT fully held + A (263 frames, bit 9 in 184, two holds, byte[16] ramping 0..255), W2 A-only again (283 frames, bit 9 in 0). 79 idle frames in W1 with bit 9 clear. All 8 criteria pass -> RT_DIGITAL_ID_9_PROVEN_LIVE. HCI: 780 notifications = 777 harness records + 2 liveness replies + D2-OFF echo; per-window capture growth verified.
